statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attacks
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and G45.9
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The concern is for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion
